posts.title: 2026 Aims
posts.description: The Ritual must continue. How did I stack up against my 2025 aims? Health ✅ Reading ✅ Painting ✅✅✅ Guitar ❌ Films ✅ Smashed it mate. What next for 2026? More of the same I think. I start a new fully remote job tomorrow and starting well will be the focus. I’d like to build a better routine around going for daily walks in daylight rather than waiting for the evening.
